body_lead: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated the nation’s first AI-powered Anganwadi in Waddhamna village, Nagpur district. This pilot center established under the ambitious Mission Bal Bharari deploys cutting-edge digital tools like artificial intelligence dashboards, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and interactive content, creating a futuristic, engaging classroom experience for young children. Historically, Anganwadi centers are grassroots childcare and preschool learning hubs serving some of India’s most underprivileged communities, primarily in rural areas.
